//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Biome Spawn Point -> Config

Enable Biome Spawn Point.//: Whether Biome Spawn Point is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

biomeSearchRadius.//: How far from the center of the world (x=0, z=0), in blocks, the mod searches for one of the spawn biomes. A larger radius finds rarer biomes, but makes creating a new world take longer. min: 256, max: 30,000

minimumDistanceFromBiomeEdge.//: How far inside the biome, in blocks, the spawn point should be, so players don't spawn just outside of it. When no spot that far inside the biome is found, a spot closer to the edge is used. min: 0, max: 128

preferSpawningOnLand.//: Whether the spawn point should be on land when the chosen biome also exists under water, like beaches that continue into the sea. A spot in water is only used when the biome has no land nearby.
